title: 香港北部都会区建设提速 建筑商承接百亿港元工程
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's such an interesting concept to the Northern Metropolis. Restartists may be said to hear a little bit more details of what this could mean, but how is the company capturing some of the infrastructure development opportunities here in the city now?
segments.zh: 北部都会区这个概念很有意思。重启者可能想听到更多细节，但公司现在如何抓住这座城市的基础设施发展机遇？

segments.en: Well, basically, the Northern Metropolis is actually setting a large area in the northern part of Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 基本上，北部都会区实际上是在香港北部划出一大片区域。

segments.en: Add adjacent to Xinjiang. Actually, that's probably about 30% of the other land area in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 毗邻新界，实际上可能占香港其他土地面积的约30%。

segments.en: And now, not many people living there, I assume there's just about 60, 600,000 people living there.
segments.zh: 现在那里居住的人不多，我估计大约有60万人住在那里。

segments.en: But in the future, probably about one-third of the Hong Kong people may be living in there.
segments.zh: 但未来，可能约三分之一的香港人可能会住在那里。

segments.en: The other thing is that bring more growth engine, rather than just finance in a town in that area,
segments.zh: 另一件事是带来更多增长引擎，而不仅仅是该地区的金融城镇，

segments.en: to make the Hong Kong's growth engine a future more balanced. So that's the key plan.
segments.zh: 使香港的增长引擎未来更加平衡。这就是关键计划。

segments.en: As in the construction sector, basically, there will be a lot of the basic infrastructure building there, residential, commercial area being building here.
segments.zh: 在建筑行业，基本上会有很多基础设施建设，住宅、商业区正在这里建设。

segments.en: We are watching this opportunity since the year of 2021 already.
segments.zh: 我们从2021年就开始关注这个机会。

segments.en: And actually, it's happening. It's not just a topic or a just thematic story.
segments.zh: 实际上，它正在发生。这不仅仅是一个话题或主题故事。

segments.en: Actually, since 2023, we have been a winning contrast here.
segments.zh: 实际上，自2023年以来，我们在这里一直表现突出。

segments.en: But now, at a stage, more in the basic infrastructure, like waste management, the basic transportation growth, things like that.
segments.zh: 但现在，更多是在基础基建领域，比如废物管理、基础交通增长等。

segments.en: It's almost like you're building a city from the ground up.
segments.zh: 这几乎就像是从头开始建设一座城市。

segments.en: Probably from nothing. Talk a bit more specifically. You mentioned some of the contracts that you've won.
segments.zh: 可能是从零开始。再具体谈谈。你提到了一些你们赢得的合同。

segments.en: What specifically are you guys doing there right now on the ground?
segments.zh: 你们目前在当地具体在做什么？
